'''Rocket packs''' were an aerial personal transportation device used across the [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that differed technologically from [[Jetpack/Legends|jet packs]].

==Characteristics==
Rocket packs were self-contained personal conveyances that created directed thrust by regulating the mixture of a large amount of combustible chemicals.<ref name="GFT" /> The units used premixed [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] and did not require [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] to operate like jetpacks.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> Because of this design, rocket packs were fully capable of operating in zero, low, or high [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and provided a better "all-environment" flight capability as a result when compared to [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]], as the latter required atmosphere to operate.<ref name="GFT" />

Typically, rocket packs were faster than jetpacks, although they were heavier and louder during operation.<ref name="GFT" /> Despite this, rocket packs offered comparable performance to jetpacks,<ref name="EGWT" /> and were considered to be more reliable, leading to their use with military forces.<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> Rocket packs tended to be more expensive to purchase.<ref name="EGWT" />

Due to weight and size restrictions, rocket packs needed to use rapid-burning elements. This meant that rocket packs had limited flight duration. If rocket packs were ruptured or damaged, the unit was at risk of detonation due to the leaking of explosive chemicals.<ref name="GFT" />

Rocket packs were most well known for being employed by the [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit]], who used the ''[[Zim Systems]]'' [[ROCKET|''ROCKET'' personal rocket pack]]. Another type of rocket pack was used by [[Rocket battle droid/Legends|rocket battle droids]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
